# Generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Read at a fine and a coarse class and on branches, the pattern goes on along some branch or ends on every branch; generation and keeping exclude degeneration and can share a point; renewal does not decide the region, and telling going on from ending is exactly excluded middle.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A carrying renewal, read at a fine class of parts and a coarse class of the pattern they make up, continues the pattern from one occurrence to the next while a part begins there; it is an alteration (火传). (`Becoming.«传»`, `Becoming.«传则异»`, `Becoming.«所及»`, `Becoming.«所及之传递»`, `Becoming.«相续之续»`)
2. On branches: the pattern goes on along some branch or ends on every branch, which exclude each other; going on along every branch is going on along some. Generation (some branch renews without end), keeping (some branch goes on without renewal) and degeneration (every branch ends) are read so; degeneration excludes both. (`Becoming.«延»`, `Becoming.«尽»`, `Becoming.«延尽不并»`, `Becoming.«不穷则延»`, `Becoming.«尽则非不穷»`, `Becoming.«生成»`, `Becoming.«守»`, `Becoming.«退化»`, `Becoming.«新而尽»`, `Becoming.«生成则延»`, `Becoming.«守则延»`, `Becoming.«生成退化不并»`, `Becoming.«守退化不并»`)
3. Generation and keeping can hold at one point, along different branches: a root whose chain renews at every step and whose other branch stays still is in both, the mixed region. On a single line, where each occurrence conditions at most one other, they exclude each other. (`Becoming.Map.Branch`, `Becoming.Map.fork`, `Becoming.Map.fork_chain_begins`, `Becoming.Map.«生守相杂»`, `Becoming.«单行则族含所及»`, `Becoming.«单行则生守不并»`)
4. The every-branch forms: generation along every branch, keeping along every branch and an end on some branch exclude each other and, with excluded middle, cover every point; generation holds along its line and an end reaches back along it; telling them apart on every line is exactly excluded middle. (`Becoming.«全生成»`, `Becoming.«全守»`, `Becoming.«有终»`, `Becoming.«新而有终»`, `Becoming.«全生成有终不并»`, `Becoming.«全生成全守不并»`, `Becoming.«全守有终不并»`, `Becoming.«全三域之周»`, `Becoming.«全生成之所及亦全生成»`, `Becoming.«有终之所前亦有终»`, `Becoming.«全生有终之定当且仅当排中»`)
5. Each region is inhabited (an endless chain generates, a still pattern keeps, a short life ends on every branch), and the short life renews and still ends, so renewal does not decide the region. Telling going on from ending at every point, in every model, is exactly excluded middle. (`Becoming.Map.step`, `Becoming.Map.step_irrefl`, `Becoming.Map.Endless.generation`, `Becoming.Map.Endless.generates`, `Becoming.Map.still`, `Becoming.Map.Still.keeping`, `Becoming.Map.Still.keeps`, `Becoming.Map.short`, `Becoming.Map.short_end`, `Becoming.Map.Short.degeneration`, `Becoming.Map.Short.ends`, `Becoming.Map.Short.renews_and_ends`, `Becoming.Map.Short.renews_and_ends_everywhere`, `Becoming.«延尽之定当且仅当排中»`)
6. A coarse class constant under 缘 has no end from a continued point, so what ends after a continued step has a coarse class that is not constant. A chain of classes reads generation at every order, and generation at an order keeps the next order's pattern from ending on every branch. (`Becoming.«有常则无终»`, `Becoming.«有终则粗不有常»`, `Becoming.«阶全生成»`, `Becoming.«阶全生成则上无终»`, `Becoming.«阶生成»`, `Becoming.«阶生成则上不退化»`)
7. On the old base (occurrences: a step and a formation): carrying renewal steps into a formation that did not carry on as itself; under passing, generation makes carriers arise arbitrarily late; by names nothing generates; consumption held, a family drawn beyond renewal and stopped passing refute going on every branch; the relay renews and ends. (`Becoming.Web.carries_iff`, `Becoming.Web.passing_carries_iff`, `Becoming.Web.generation_renews_late`, `Becoming.Web.generation_arises_late`, `Becoming.Web.keeping_of_carried_on`, `Becoming.Web.itself_not_generation`, `Becoming.Web.always_keeps`, `Becoming.Web.degenerates_of_gone`, `Becoming.Web.consumed_held_not_endless`, `Becoming.Web.family_excess_not_endless`, `Becoming.Web.stopped_not_endless`, `Becoming.Map.shifted_generates`, `Becoming.Map.relay_renews_and_ends`, `Becoming.Map.renewal_undecided`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- None beyond the grammar: every carrier, every relation read as 缘, a fine and a coarse class; the covering law takes excluded middle as a hypothesis.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That generation here is the 生生 of life in the whole: it is the continuation of a pattern through renewal of its parts, with no premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good.
- That the regions are decided: at a given point, whether the pattern goes on is in general not decided. Witness: `Becoming.«延尽之定当且仅当排中»`.
- That generation and keeping exclude each other where lines branch: a point can lie in both. Witness: `Becoming.Map.«生守相杂»`.
- That renewal is generation: a line can renew and still end. Witness: `Becoming.Map.Short.renews_and_ends`.
- **Counterexample:** A short life of two occurrences renews (its second occurrence begins a new part) and ends on every branch (Map.Short.renews_and_ends_everywhere). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarMap.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.

### Correspondence

(2024); the decidability calibration matches the old base's LastChange.lpo_iff_settles in form. Correspondences not proved.
